meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to the L1 vendor (B); no approval flow
gaps: The prepared closed RFQ has only one bid, so the two bids A 100 and B 90 and identification of Vendor B as L1 cannot be tested.
Allocating exactly 10 units to Vendor B and asserting Awarded Vendors is 1/2 cannot be tested because the prepared state has one vendor and allocate_award only supports vendor-level allocation.
Filling and submitting the proposal with the requested two-bid allocation cannot be verified for Vendor B; award_event can only submit the available lowest-bid award.
Verifying that the award is final without any approval flow cannot be distinguished from the catalog's create_po flow, which completes approval internally.

plan.title: Award Lowest Bid and Create PO

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with its available bid.
Award the available lowest bid and submit the award proposal in the supported one-bid state.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the supported award flow and create the purchase order.
Assert that the resulting purchase order contains the event's single awarded line with quantity 10.
Open the History tab where completed events should appear.
Assert that this plan's awarded event appears in History.
